value.rationale: The least lag with strict global total-variation contraction is a well-motivated natural ergodic invariant for a conditioned time-series model. It has a sharp nonobvious three-regime transition: no contraction at any finite lag, strict one-step contraction, or only two-step contraction. The explicit parameter bounds quantify initialization and observation-spacing costs and make the otherwise qualitative stationary-law theory operational.
